claims.text: GDACS assessed Tropical Cyclone SAUDEL-26 at an Overall Orange alert (medium humanitarian impact), with peak sustained winds of 213 km/h (Category 4) and approximately 3.5 million people exposed to Category 1 (120 km/h) or higher winds across the Northern Mariana Islands, Japan and China; the event window runs 18-24 August 2026, with a maximum storm surge forecast for 27 August 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

description: Tropical Cyclone Saudel intensified to Category 4 strength (213 km/h sustained winds) in the Philippine Sea in mid-August 2026, tracking toward Japan's Ryukyu Islands after affecting the Northern Mariana Islands. GDACS assessed the storm at an Overall Orange alert (medium humanitarian impact), with approximately 3.5 million people exposed to Category 1 or higher winds across the Northern Mariana Islands, Japan and China. As of 24 August 2026 the storm had not yet made landfall and no death, injury or displacement figure has been confirmed by an authoritative source; a maximum storm surge is forecast for 27 August 2026.

No death, injury or displacement figure has been confirmed by an authoritative source as of 24 August 2026, and a maximum storm surge is forecast for 27 August 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
